A beach 3 miles long. Gosh that sounds impressive, until you realise the beach just across the bay called Cefn Sidan is 7 miles long and is regularly used by the airforces of several countries to practice sand landing and take off's with transport aircraft.
Cefn Sidan beach is also the designated emergency 'crash landing' beach that passenger airliners would use in an emergency, the beach being so straight and free of rocks.

A large passenger plane cannot sink in the high tide and drown any survivors as a rule, the water depth being shallow enough at high tide.
